en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Ishaq al-Dinuri narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Muhammad b. Sulayman al-Baghdadi informed me. He said: Muhammad b. `Umar narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ja`far narrated to us. He said: `Ubaydullah b. `Amr narrated to us from Zayd b. Abi Aniyya from Abi Ishaq from al-`Ala’ from Ibn `Umar. The Prophet (s) said:
Close the doors to the Mosque except for the door of `Ali.
